sentences.en: Such conduct would subject the offender to a heavy penalty.
sentences.zh: 这种行为会使违规者面临严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: It's always disappointing when you lose a match on penalties.
sentences.zh: 在点球大战中输掉比赛总是令人失望的。

sentences.en: Union members railed against proposals to cut weekend penalty rates.
sentences.zh: 工会成员反对削减周末加班费的提议，对此表示强烈不满。
